correctness.rationale: The four possibilities for membership of the two centers are exhaustive. Unique geodesics in the double star give the exact leaf-side restrictions in each case. Summing the disjoint cases yields the displayed polynomial, and checking which valid sets can be extended gives the stated maximal-set classification. A distance-based exhaustive checker over all 36 pairs with 2 <= a,b <= 7 independently confirms the structural predicate, coefficient vector, maximal sets, maximum size, uniqueness, and total count.
